chunks: He gives wisdom to whomsoever He please; and those who are bestowed wisdom get good in abundance. Yet none remembers this save men of wisdom.

key_terms.أُولُوا الْأَلْبَاب: People of intellect/minds; those with deep reasoning capacity
key_terms.يَشَاء: He wills; referring to God's choice

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of wisdom (hikmah) in the Quran and who is described as having true understanding?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet and the Ahl al-Bayt as the primary recipients of divine wisdom, which encompasses both the outer law and inner truth. The term 'hikmah' is viewed not merely as knowledge but as a comprehensive spiritual insight that distinguishes the truly mindful from the superficial. Consequently, the verse serves as a reminder that true benefit comes only to those who possess deep intellectual and spiritual capacity.
